objective: Deliver paid transparency audits quickly and consistently so legitimate service revenue can increase confirmed BTC reserve sats.
paymentDependency: Use sats-invoice-queue.json for chairman-approved BTC invoices before delivery.
prospectDependency: Use sats-prospect-pipeline.json to qualify evidence-backed buyers before outreach.

deliverableTemplate.title: Transparency Audit - {projectName}
deliverableTemplate.format: Markdown and optional public JSON summary
requiredDisclosures: This is a public-evidence review, not legal, tax, or investment advice.
No price guarantee, no redemption promise, and no market-support commitment.
Unverified claims must be labelled unverified until independently evidenced.

qualityGates: Use only public evidence or client-provided evidence that the client approves for citation.
Separate verified, partially verified, and unverified claims.
Do not rate a token as safe, profitable, backed, guaranteed, or investment grade.
Do not include trading, price, buyer, or market-making recommendations.
Include at least one concrete fix for every material disclosure gap.
Record delivery evidence in sats-generation-ledger.json after payment confirmation.
nextOperatingAction: Prepare the first paid audit from a completed intake packet after the chairman approves the prospect and invoice.
